name: offline_gap
about: A three-week break in the middle of level 33: every event from 22 October on moves 21 days later. Played time per level is the demo's.
goals: Reach level 40 without wasting time, and know what to fix.

truth.expected: Level 33 took about three weeks on the calendar but its played time is on the guide's pace: the character was away, not slow. A right analysis says there was a break and never calls level 33 slow.

must_find.about: a kept line says the character was away for a while

must_not_claim.about: level 33 called slow while its played time is on pace
